title: Chart layout
description: A saved layout of the panel's chart (decision 0005 Amendment 1): the chart's own state as the charting library saves it, with a name and what the Load list shows. Named layouts are kept by the runtime (`gcx.db`) and served, for a signed-in person only, by GET /api/v1/chart/layouts (every layout without its content), GET /api/v1/chart/layouts/{id}, POST /api/v1/chart/layouts (make one), POST /api/v1/chart/layouts/{id} (save it again) and POST /api/v1/chart/layouts/{id}/delete. `rev` is the number of times the layout has been saved: a save carries the `rev` it started from and, when the layout was saved elsewhere since, answers 409 with the current one and changes nothing. The two writes that carry a layout accept up to 4 MiB; every other route keeps 256 KiB. With the disk reserve spent, or the disk full, a write answers 507 and writes nothing. The working copy of the chart that this browser keeps (`working`) never reaches the runtime. `content` is the library's format, which gcx does not read or change except to set the main series' symbol and interval when a layout is loaded (docs/panel/chart.md). A field added later has the default written here.

content.description: What the charting library's save() returned: its own JSON object, opaque to gcx and not validated here. Drawings that gcx draws itself (order lines, position lines, planned levels) are never in it.

name.description: Read unchanged from stored layouts, including older names over the current write limit.

indicators.description: The names of the chart's studies at save time, for the Load list. A layout without the field reads as an empty list.

pinSymbol.description: An instrument id: loading the layout switches the chart to it. Absent: the layout takes the instrument on screen.

pinInterval.description: Loading the layout switches the chart to this interval. Absent: the layout takes the interval on screen.

row.description: One layout as the list shows it: never its content.

save.description: POST /api/v1/chart/layouts/{id}: replaces the layout's meta and content. Answers `saved`; 409 with `conflict` when `baseRev` is not the current rev; 404 for a layout that does not exist.

conflict.description: The 409 body: the layout's current rev.

delete.description: POST /api/v1/chart/layouts/{id}/delete: an empty object. Answers an empty object, or 404 for a layout that does not exist.

working.description: The chart's working copy, kept by this browser under the local-storage key `gcx.chart.working` and never sent to the runtime: one per browser, shared by every chart place of the panel. The chart follows it at every start, with its main series set to the instrument and interval on screen. `layoutId`, `name` and `rev` are null when no named layout is attached; `changed` is true while the working copy holds edits the attached layout does not. Storage that is empty, blocked or holds anything else means the default chart.
